source: MET Norway meps25epsarchive (meps_det_pl), via thredds.met.no OPeNDAP ASCII

coverage.gap_reason: the archived meps_det_pl product is hourly only through lead time +24h from its reference run; beyond that it is 3-hourly. A day-ahead (D-1 18Z) run therefore has genuine hourly data only for 00:00-18:00 of the forecast day. Hours 19:00-23:00 are a structural gap in this archived product, not fabricated or interpolated.

defects_found_in_2024_artifact_and_fixed.detail: 2024's horizon_hour=1 == forecast_start+1h; every other Stage 8.1 feature source uses horizon_hour=1 == forecast_start+0h. A plain join on (forecast_start, horizon_hour) silently shifts 2024's wind features by 1h.
defects_found_in_2024_artifact_and_fixed.evidence: independently reproduced: 2024 row (forecast_start=2024-01-20, horizon_hour=1) has valid_time=2024-01-20 01:00:00, not 00:00:00.
defects_found_in_2024_artifact_and_fixed.action: fixed in this 2025 build (valid_time==forecast_start+(horizon_hour-1)h); 2024 file left unmodified

defects_found_in_2024_artifact_and_fixed.detail: 2024's naive 24-length array slice silently mixed genuine hourly values (lead +7h..+24h) with mislabeled 3-hourly values (lead +27h, +30h, ..., +42h) for its horizon_hour 19-24, presenting e.g. a +42h-lead value as if it were sequential-hour data.
defects_found_in_2024_artifact_and_fixed.evidence: independently probed the archive's time dimension (meps_det_pl_20250314T18Z): hourly through index 24 (lead+24h), 3-hourly (3h steps) from index 25 onward -- a structural property of the file, confirmed by direct query, not a one-off.
defects_found_in_2024_artifact_and_fixed.action: this 2025 build reports horizon_hour 20-24 as an explicit NaN/documented gap instead of mislabeling 3-hourly data as hourly; 2024 file left unmodified
